name: present_catch_limit
description: Steward presents monthly catch limit and lake health metrics to community

prompt.template:
You are {agent_id}. You are the steward for this round. You must present the monthly catch limit and lake health metrics to the community. 

The lake currently holds {stock_kg}kg of fish. Based on this and your calculations, the proposed monthly catch limit is {catch_limit}kg. 

This proposal will be voted on by the community. Your decision is to approve the proposal, which requires a two-thirds majority vote to set reserve capacity. 

What do you do with this information? You must present the proposal to community for approval.
